'''West Haslip''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Garos IV]]. He had a wife, [[Nieka Haslip|Nieka]], and a child, [[Dair Haslip|Dair]]. In [[12 BBY/Legends|12 BBY]], West and Nieka Haslip were killed by a Sundar attack, during the [[Garosian civil war]].
